title: The Prophets of Mall World Pt.1
content: I had a series of Mall World dreams over the last 4 nights any I managed to write them down as they seem to be a continuous story. I used fiction to fill the gaps as well as AI tools for translation (no native speaker), grammar and the illustrations. If you like it I will provide the other parts later (I'm laying on the beach atm) Part 1 - The Tailor Shop I wake up in an empty room with a bed, a chair, and a window. I look out the window and see an idyllic old town on a cliff overgrown with lush greenery. In the background, I see how the concrete desert of the city extends to the sea. The Hub is visible. So this is where I landed again. How did I get here anyway? The last time I was in the parking garage library on the outskirts of town, I must have walked because I remember not finding my car. I continue to look around and notice old building charm and a wooden door. I open the door and find myself in a long hallway. Suddenly something buzzes inside me. Is it a telephone? I feel it, but it's not coming out of my pants. Pants? I'm not wearing any! How embarrassing! It keeps humming. Where is it coming from? They didn't put it inside me, did they? No, it's right under my skin. The door opens and several people enter. I feel caught. Do they hear this humming as I literally stand in front of them with my pants down? I leave the room and walk down the hallway, trying to open doors. All locked except for one that creaks open. It's a tailor shop judging by the work tools. I close the door and look around: scissors, fabric, needle and thread, disinfectant - very good! A wall mirror and a hand mirror are also there. Footsteps outside the door - no key! I barricade the door with a chair and get to work. Here below my right hip, I feel it just under the skin. A little bathroom surgery later, it's done - the bleeding stopped. Blood everywhere! Let those who put this thing under my skin clean up the mess. I look at the vibrating something - a bloody egg flashing blue is in front of me. What is the purpose of this device? Suddenly there is a knock on the door - gentle at first, then more urgent, finally so strong that I am afraid the door will burst off its hinges. I open the door on the opposite side - another hallway. I fight my way through more rooms and eventually my captors are cut off and I'm out in the open. At this point, I leave the Mallworld and wake up in reality.
